messages:
Maya: quick async standup for Citrine Health renewal liaison — TL;DR: customer adoption dipped on onboarding flows, renewal conversation next week.
Maya: what I did: followed up with infra about webhook backfill, verified retry logic deployed to staging, ran adoption query (see numbers below), left voice note for PM.
Maya: blocker: Citrine rotated their auth header last week and some of our retries are hitting 401/500 in prod; need eng to confirm header handling + whether token rotation should trigger a retry/backoff.
Maya: today: I will consolidate logs (last 7d), prepare a 2-slide summary for the renewal call, and sync w/ @Arjun for the auth fix.
Maya: adoption metric snapshot: onboarding_active_weekly dropped from 78% -> 61% over 14 days; embeddings similarity median fell 0.72 -> 0.58 on sample prompt set.
Arjun: I can take point on the auth header — saw the 401s around 03:12 UTC yesterday. quick check: can you paste the failing request header example?
Maya: pasted the curl that failed in staging: ```curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Customer-ID: citrine-01" https://hooks.citrine.prod/push```
Arjun: aha, looks like the token header has an extra newline in some rotated tokens (we saw similar in acmefin). I'll push a small patch to trim whitespace on the token parsing by EOD.
Lina: thanks. on the CS side I've got the renewal call scheduled for Tue 10am PT — Citrine asked for a short action plan before then. can eng produce a one-paragraph mitigation and ETA? I can include in the customer note.
Sam: if trimming doesn't stop the 500s, we should consider routing Citrine to the fallback ingestion endpoint for a short window. we have capacity to handle their burst for the next 72h. ping me and I can flip routing config. :+1:
Arjun: noted. plan: (1) patch token trim today, (2) add better 401->retry semantics for rotated tokens, (3) instrument request-level tag so CS can see when routing fallback is active. estimate: patch + deploy to staging in 3h, prod deploy after smoke tests ~6h.
Maya: perfect — Lina I'll draft the one-paragraph: "We identified intermittent auth header formatting from Citrine's token rotation causing failed webhooks. Engineering will deploy a token-trim fix and improved retry behavior today; if failures persist we will route to a fallback ingestion endpoint temporarily. Expected containment within 24 hours, full resolution within 72 hours." ok to send?
Lina: yeah that reads well. can you add the ETA numbers you just gave? then I'll send to the customer.
Maya: added ETAs and sent to Cala (Citrine PM).
DevOps Bot: deploy started by @Arjun: patch/token-trim v1.2.3 -> staging (build 8921).
Arjun: staging smoke looks green so far, one flaky 502 in long-tail which looks unrelated. kicking prod deploy in 15m.
Sam: FYI — if we flip routing, I'll also coordinate with billing to avoid overages on their account during the trial window.
Maya: blocker resolved? awaiting prod deploy; I'll monitor logs and flag any customer messages. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Lina: thanks team — I'll update the renewal playbook with the temporary routing option and link to this thread for handoff.
